headline: Two-person path: novel unit-op → government Phase I → hire and build a skid → verify a kilogram → expand
not_this: This is not a second Round Top. GLO leases are held. CHIPS, Texas SIF, and the $134M DOE demo FOA are the wrong weight class. Do not model 20,000 tpd as your tonnes.
disclaimer: Award sizes are cited class, not a promise a window is open tomorrow. Daily job must flip window status before anyone writes a proposal. Not investment advice. Not affiliated with USAR, TMRC, or any grantee named as analog.
review_hooks: Next NSF 26-510 SBIR/STTR Phase I deadline live?
Next DOE or DLA SBIR topic that names REE / Dy / magnet scrap?
DLA Strategic Materials BAA SP8000-26-B-BAA0 still rolling?
Named feedstock (swarf PO or synthetic Y-heavy sulfate) in hand, or still a slide?

wedges.name: F / U / Th cut on yttrofluorite-class sulfate PLS
wedges.why: Comparison tab ranks this #2 and still has no public Round Top mass balance. Patent claims a two-stage U/Th contact; dollars and F residual are unknown.
wedges.metric: Dy left in solution, F and Th rejected, extractant still alive after N contacts

wedges.name: Dy / Y split when Y >> Dy
wedges.why: PC88A only prefers Dy about 3–4×. A better β, a hollow-fiber SLM / IL-PIM, or an LN-resin polish that cuts mixer-settler count is the fundable claim. Literature SLMs often move Y, not Dy-first.
wedges.metric: β(Dy/Y) and stage or module count vs PC88A on a Y-heavy sulfate+F liquor; hours of flux before F kills the pore fill
wedges.not: A reprint of Thakur 2000 on monazite chloride.

wedges.name: Swarf → magnet-spec Dy2O3 on a modular skid
wedges.why: Feed is already concentrated. USAR, Momentum, HyProMag, and others are in this pond; you win on $/kg, radionuclides, or a skid a finisher will park.
wedges.metric: kg Dy2O3 out per kg swarf in, with third-party assay

ladder.name: Claim
ladder.what: One sentence metric. Named feed (bought swarf or synthetic Y-rich sulfate+F). LLC + SAM/UEI. IP in the company. No GLO-lease story.

ladder.name: Prove (Phase I)
ladder.who: 2 people, rented hood, no full-time hire yet
ladder.cash: NSF Phase I up to $305k / 6–18 mo; DOE Phase I ~$200–250k class; DLA Phase I ~$100k / 12 mo class
ladder.what: 1–10 L mass balance. Independent assay. Report β, F residual, U/Th rejection, extractant cycles. Revenue = $0. That is fine.

ladder.name: Hire + build
ladder.cash: Phase II NSF up to $1.25M; DLA/DOE Phase II ~$1M / 18 mo; CMI Accelerator Topic 1A up to ~$2M at 20% cost share
ladder.what: One skid (columns, hollow-fiber, or small SX) — not a pad, not 500 mixer-settlers. Run on someone else's feed. Cost share starts here.

ladder.name: Verify
ladder.cash: Same Phase II pot; first paid sample or toll kg
ladder.what: Kilograms from a named real feed. Third-party assay a magnet shop will read. Qualification letter. Samples are not verify. A PO is.

ladder.name: Expand
ladder.cash: Private + Phase III / BAA Phase II. Not CHIPS.
ladder.what: Clone skids, toll kg→t, or license the unit-op to whoever runs a heap. Still not 20,000 tpd. Charge $/kg Dy recovered or per tonne of liquor treated.

grants.name: NSF SBIR/STTR 26-510 Phase I / II
grants.usd: Phase I up to $305k; Phase II up to $1.25M
grants.window: program live; next full-proposal deadline 4 Nov 2026 (27 Jul 2026 passed). Pitch invitation still required.
grants.fit: Best first check. No equity. Pays a coupon β or 1–10 L SLM/IL mass balance — not a heap.

grants.name: DLA novel REE separation SBIR (class)
grants.usd: Phase I $100k / 12 mo; Phase II $1M / 18 mo
grants.fit: Names Dy. TRL 3–6, modular, ITAR/EAR. Use as the template for the next DoD cycle, not as an open door.

grants.name: DLA Strategic Materials BAA SP8000-26-B-BAA0
grants.usd: Phase I ≤ SAT; Phase II up to $10M / 3 yr
grants.fit: Covers NdFeB recycle and REE recovery. White paper, not a 200-page NOFO.

grants.name: DOE CMI Accelerator Topic 1A/1B scrap
grants.usd: Phase 1 up to ~$2M (20% cost share); Phase 2 up to ~$8M class
grants.fit: Hire+build money. Magnet swarf is on-topic. Need a bench before you apply.

grants.name: DOE REE Demonstration Facility ($134M class)
grants.fit: Phoenix Tailings / university consortia. Not a 2-person start.

kill: Pitching a heap or a GLO lease.
Generic PC88A with a new brand name.
Writing CHIPS or Texas SIF as the first grant.
Hiring a CEO before a chemist who has run mixer-settlers.
